findings.comment: Buildings are proposed and existing overhead electric facilities are shown on site (Existing Conditions Survey, Sheet 4). However, surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are not included on building elevation sheets or any submitted plan to demonstrate 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained from outside conductor.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings with overhangs, awnings, balconies, or projections
findings.comment: Surveyed elevations and clearance dimensions from overhead electric conductors to building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs) are not provided on building elevation sheets or profile views. Both 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances must be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings proposed adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way
findings.comment: Overhead electric facilities exist in the right-of-way of Valley View Road adjacent to the site. Clearance dimensions from buildings to overhead conductors in the ROW are not documented on site plan or profile exhibits. Both 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances must be verified and dimensionally shown.

Surveyed elevations and locations of existing overhead electric conductors are not included on any building elevation sheets to demonstrate required clearances are met. No registered surveyor data is provided showing conductor elevations and mid-span clearances relative to building faces and projections.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and site features within potential clearance distance of overhead facilities
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings and building projections for clearance verification are not provided. No dimension lines originating from conductor locations are shown on any submitted plans.

Driveway locations exist beneath or adjacent to existing overhead electric facilities shown on the site. Vertical clearance dimensions from the lowest point of overhead facilities to finished driveway grades are not documented on grading plan or section views. Minimum 16-foot clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot clearance (areas with truck traffic) must be verified with mid-span clearance data.

applicableAreas: Site locations where clearance dimensions are shown
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on plans. However, if clearances are dimensioned in future submittals, dimensions must originate from outside conductor location, not from utility pole centerline or pole structure, particularly critical on multi-conductor installations where conductor offset from pole center may be several feet.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas adjacent to overhead electric facilities on west and north boundaries
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows proposed trees (marked M for mitigation trees) planted in close proximity to existing overhead electric facilities. Trees appear to be within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors based on visual scale analysis. However, specific tree species are not identified on the landscape plan, and no indication is provided of which species are Utility Compatible per ECM Appendix F. Required documentation must specify species for all proposed trees within 50 lateral feet of transmission lines and 10 lateral feet of distribution lines, with confirmation of Utility Compatible status (UC marking) for non-compliant distances.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general site notes
findings.comment: Required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines is not included on the cover sheet or general notes. Per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003, this notification requirement must be prominently noted on plans.
